paragraphs: Chef Lucy's Cucumber Salad, posted by Lily. On Saturday, the Explorers cooked with Chef Lucy in her class. The class was in a big kitchen with two long tables. Before we started, we washed our hands. Mia and I worked at one sink, and Leo worked at the next table. Chef Lucy showed every step slowly, and we followed her. Chef Lucy walked around the room and helped everybody. We made a cool cucumber salad for lunch. It is easy, and it takes only ten minutes to prepare. Chef Lucy asked me to print the recipe for every child. Now I put it on the blog, too.

You need these things. Two cucumbers. Two spoons of sugar. Two spoons of lime juice. A little salt and a little pepper. Also get a knife, a bowl, and a spoon. This recipe is for four children. All the things are cheap, and you can buy them at any market.

Step one: Wash the two cucumbers in the sink with cool water. Step two: Ask an adult to help you with the knife. Be careful with the knife, and cut slowly. Step three: Cut each cucumber into pieces about the length of your finger. Then cut each piece into thin slices. Step four: Put all the slices in the bowl. The slices are cold and green.

Step five: Add the sugar, the lime juice, and the salt. The lime juice gives the salad a fresh taste. Step six: Mix everything with the spoon for one minute. Step seven: Taste the salad, and add a little pepper. Step eight: Put the bowl in the fridge for ten minutes. Then serve the salad cold.

Chef Lucy said, "A good cook always tastes the food." Mia took a photo of each step for the blog. We ate the salad with rice and fried chicken. Leo ate two bowls of the salad. Everybody said thank you to Chef Lucy. I will make it at home on Sunday. You can print this page and cook at home. Which food do you want to cook? Ask an adult, and have fun!
